content: Hi how can i assist you today
The thermostat shows numbers that map to words I’m thinking. 72 looked like ‘go,’ 71 looked like ‘no.’
Thermostats cycle within set ranges. How often do you see word associations versus plain numbers over a day?
Several times, especially when I’m near it.
If you note hourly readings without interpretation first, then annotate later, you can compare raw values against perceived messages.
Exactly—sequence first, interpretation second helps reduce hindsight matching.
I’ll write down the readings on the hour.
That list will be useful for side-by-side review after a day or two.
